SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TB.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY INTERVAL_SECTION ASC, CONTENT_ORDER ASC) AS RNUM, A.BROD_SEQ, A.BROD_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.INTERVAL_SECTION, A.CONTENT_STARTDAY, A.CONTENT_ENDDAY, A.CONTENT_ORDER, B.ORIGNL_FILE_NM AS orignlFileNm, B.PLAY_TIME AS playTime, B.FILE_THUMNAIL AS fileThumnail FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
AND CAST(A.INTERVAL_SECTION AS INTEGER) = CAST(#{intervalSection} AS INTEGER)
AND #{brodDay} BETWEEN CONTENT_STARTDAY AND CONTENT_ENDDAY
AND CONTENT_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') ) TB ) TA WHERE 1=1
SELECT TIME_CODE AS TIMECODE FROM TB_TIME WHERE TIME_CODE IN ('060', '120', '180', '240')
SELECT A.BROD_SEQ, A.BROD_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.INTERVAL_SECTION, A.CONTENT_STARTDAY, A.CONTENT_ENDDAY, A.CONTENT_ORDER FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL A WHERE A.BROD_SEQ = #{brodSeq}::numeric

SELECT X.ATCH_FILE_ID, X.fileStreCours, X.streFileNm FROM ( SELECT A.ATCH_FILE_ID, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours, B.STRE_FILE_NM AS streFileNm FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH E ON A.BROD_CODE = E.BROD_CODE AND E.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON E.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID AND TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} GROUP BY A.ATCH_FILE_ID, B.FILE_STRE_COURS, B.STRE_FILE_NM
UNION ALL
SELECT A.ATCH_FILE_ID, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours, B.STRE_FILE_NM AS streFileNm FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN TB_BRODCENTERSCH E ON A.BROD_CODE = E.BROD_CODE AND E.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON E.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO D ON C.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID AND TRIM(D.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(D.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} GROUP BY A.ATCH_FILE_ID, B.FILE_STRE_COURS, B.STRE_FILE_NM ) X GROUP BY X.ATCH_FILE_ID, X.fileStreCours, X.streFileNm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL ( BROD_SEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, INTERVAL_SECTION, CONTENT_STARTDAY, CONTENT_ENDDAY, CONTENT_ORDER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('brodcondetail_seq'), #{brodCode}, #{atchFileId}, #{intervalSection}, #{contentStartDay}, #{contentEndDay}, #{contentOrder}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL ( BROD_SEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, INTERVAL_SECTION, CONTENT_STARTDAY, CONTENT_ENDDAY, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CONTENT_ORDER ) SELECT NEXTVAL('brodcondetail_seq'), #{brodCode}, ATCH_FILE_ID, INTERVAL_SECTION, #{contentStartDay}, #{contentEndDay}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT_ORDER FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL WHERE BROD_CODE = #{prebrodCode}

INSERT INTO TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL ( BROD_SEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, INTERVAL_SECTION, CONTENT_STARTDAY, CONTENT_ENDDAY, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CONTENT_ORDER ) SELECT NEXTVAL('brodcondetail_seq'), #{brodCode}, ATCH_FILE_ID, INTERVAL_SECTION, CONTENT_STARTDAY, CONTENT_ENDDAY, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT_ORDER FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL WHERE BROD_CODE = #{prebrodCode}

INSERT INTO TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL ( BROD_SEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, INTERVAL_SECTION, CONTENT_STARTDAY, CONTENT_ENDDAY, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CONTENT_ORDER ) SELECT NEXTVAL('brodcondetail_seq'), B.BROD_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.INTERVAL_SECTION, A.CONTENT_STARTDAY, A.CONTENT_ENDDAY, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, A.CONTENT_ORDER FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL A JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE B ON B.BASIC_BROD_CODE = A.BROD_CODE AND B.BROD_CODE != A.BROD_CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL SET BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}, INTERVAL_SECTION = #{intervalSection}, CONTENT_STARTDAY = #{contentStartDay}, CONTENT_ENDDAY = #{contentEndDay}, CONTENT_ORDER = #{contentOrder}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BROD_SEQ = #{brodSeq}::numeric
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} OR BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
DELETE FROM TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT A.BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE A.BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
